words: Click a page to turn it.

Before the sun clears the ridge, the valley is blue and completely still. Then the light arrives all at once, and the red rock seems to switch on. Our guide Salem has watched it six thousand times and still stops talking when it happens.
The dunes move about four metres a year. The camp you stay in this spring may be gone by the next.
“Nobody hurries in the desert. The desert taught me to cook slowly, too.”
— Umm Hani, who has cooked for travellers for 31 years
